title: Spicy Haricot Bean Stir Fry
description: A quick and delicious Thai-inspired stir fry made with haricot beans, garlic, and a hint of spice.

ingredients.name: stir-fry mix
ingredients.notes: such as bell peppers, carrots, etc.

instructions: Heat vegetable oil in a wok or large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add garlic and chili peppers (if using) and stir-fry until fragrant.
Add stir-fry mix and cook until tender.
Add haricot beans and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes.
Season with light soy sauce and serve over rice.
Garnish with additional chili peppers or garlic if desired.
Optional: Serve with a side of steamed vegetables or a simple salad.
